note: Plain-words recommendations for the year-end test pack. expected: updated | manual_review (with reason_code).

recommendations.text: In the income statement, the gross margin line should be called gross profit.
Shorten the Sales and Marketing expense line to just Marketing, and rename Other Income, Net to Other Operating Income, Net.
Under Cost of Sales, rename the Product line to Goods. Leave the Product line under Net Sales as it is.
Add the abbreviation to the in-process research line: In-Process Research and Development (R&D).
In the disclaimer, say entirely at your own risk instead of strictly at your own risk, and refer to us as Northwind Group instead of Smartsheet.
Remove the green Try Smartsheet for FREE button at the top.
Fix the typo at the start of the executive summary text: it should read In its first year.
Fill in our company name, NORTHWIND GROUP, where the cover says COMPANY NAME.
Rename the gross margin line to gross profit and print the column headers in blue.
Make the income statement labels clearer for readers.
Say entirely at your own risk instead of strictly at your own risk.
In the summary of significant accounting policies, drop the word monthly from the projected cash flows sentence.
recommendations.note: the section and the cash-flow sentence named are not on the page: the editor must ask, not guess
